This chapter is about learning: **to study** (درس — daras) and **to learn** (اتعلم — et3allim), with the subjects, languages, music, and culture that come with them. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

Egyptian uses two different verbs where English blurs them. **درس** is formal *study* — a subject, at school or university. **اتعلم** is *to learn / pick up* — a skill, a language, an instrument.

| Verb | Use | Example |
|---|---|---|
| درس - daras | formal study (a subject) | بدرس طب — badris tibb — I study medicine |
| اتعلم - et3allim | learning a skill or language | بتعلم عربي — bat3allim 3araby — I'm learning Arabic |

A useful relative is **درّس (darras)** "to teach" (*ana badarres* "I teach") — the teacher's side of the same activity.

## To study — درس — daras

Regular verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana hadris*); past: *ana darast, huwwa daras*.

| Pronoun | Present |
|---|---|
| أنا - ana | بدرس - badris |
| إنت - inta | بتدرس - bitidris |
| إنتِ - inti | بتدرسي - bitidresi |
| هو - huwwa | بيدرس - biyidris |
| هي - hiyya | بتدرس - bitidris |
| إحنا - e7na | بندرس - binidris |
| إنتو - intu | بتدرسوا - bitidresu |
| هم - humma | بيدرسوا - biyidresu |

## To learn — اتعلم — et3allim

Reflexive verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana hat3allim*); past: *ana it3allimt, huwwa it3allim*.

| Pronoun | Present |
|---|---|
| أنا - ana | باتعلم - bat3allim |
| إنت - inta | بتتعلم - bitit3allim |
| إنتِ - inti | بتتعلمي - bitit3allimi |
| هو - huwwa | بيتعلم - biyit3allim |
| هي - hiyya | بتتعلم - bitit3allim |
| إحنا - e7na | بنتعلم - binit3allim |
| إنتو - intu | بتتعلموا - bitit3allimu |
| هم - humma | بيتعلموا - biyit3allimu |

## Subjects (with درس)

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| طب - tibb | medicine |
| هندسة - handasa | engineering |
| حقوق - 7o2oo2 | law |
| اقتصاد - e2tisad | economics |
| تاريخ - tari5 | history |
| علوم - 3oloom | science |
| فنون - fonoon | arts |

(For languages, see the *Speaking and Understanding* chapter — *3araby, engelizi, faransawi…*)

## Music and instruments (with اتعلم)

To say you play an instrument, use **عزف (yi3zef)** "to play": *bat3allim a3zef 3ood* "I'm learning to play the oud".

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| موسيقى - mosi2a | music |
| آلة - aala | instrument |
| عود - 3ood | oud (lute) |
| جيتار - gitar | guitar |
| بيانو - biano | piano |
| كمان - kaman | violin |
| طبلة - tabla | tabla / drum |
| غنا - 8ena | singing |

## Culture

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| ثقافة - sa2afa | culture |
| فن - fann | art |
| رقص - ra2s | dance |
| مسرح - masra7 | theatre |
| سينما - cinema | cinema |

## Dialogue: "What do you study?"

Hesham and Farida talk about study and hobbies.

<span class="rotulo">هشام — Hesham</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتدرسي إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bitidresi eh?</span>
<span class="en">What do you study?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">فريدة — Farida</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بدرس حقوق في الجامعة</summary>
<span class="fr">badris 7o2oo2 fi el-gam3a</span>
<span class="en">I study law at university</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هشام — Hesham</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وبتتعلمي حاجة تانية؟</summary>
<span class="fr">we bitit3allimi 7aga tanya?</span>
<span class="en">And are you learning anything else?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">فريدة — Farida</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، بتعلم أعزف بيانو</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, bat3allim a3zef biano</span>
<span class="en">Yes, I'm learning to play the piano</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هشام — Hesham</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>حلو! أنا بحب الموسيقى أوي</summary>
<span class="fr">7elw! ana ba7ebb el-mosi2a awi</span>
<span class="en">Nice! I love music a lot</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">فريدة — Farida</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وإنت بتدرس ولا بتشتغل؟</summary>
<span class="fr">wenta bitidris walla bitishta8al?</span>
<span class="en">And do you study or work?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هشام — Hesham</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بشتغل، بس بتعلم لغات في وقت فراغي</summary>
<span class="fr">bashta8al, bas bat3allim lo8at fi wa2t fara8i</span>
<span class="en">I work, but I learn languages in my free time</span>
</details>

### Exercise 2 — درس or اتعلم؟

Pick the verb that fits the meaning.

**1.** to ___ medicine at university

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">درس</span>
<span class="fr">badris tibb — formal study</span>
</details>

**2.** to ___ Arabic

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">اتعلم</span>
<span class="fr">bat3allim 3araby — learning a language</span>
</details>

**3.** to ___ to play the guitar

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">اتعلم</span>
<span class="fr">bat3allim a3zef gitar — learning a skill</span>
</details>

**4.** to ___ law

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">درس</span>
<span class="fr">badris 7o2oo2 — formal study</span>
</details>
